{{Quote|I want to cripple them. They hurt and kill our citizens and they must be executed. I want them rendered ineffective and then wiped out.|Ceth Laike, about Corellian criminals|<ref name="SWG:E" />}}
'''Ceth Laike''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|My friend must be dead. The good news is that they finally stepped over the line.|Ceth Laike, to an Imperial operative|<ref name="SWG:E" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Ceth Laike was based in [[Talus Imperial Outpost|Imperial Military Outpost]] on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="SWG:E" />

[[File:Crashed_TIE_bomber_Talus.jpg|250px|thumb|left|The copse of the Imperial pilot near his crashed TIE bomber]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Battle on Talus|battle]] took place on Talus between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. During the battle, a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]] was shot down by Rebel forces. Fortunately, the [[TIE pilot|pilot]], a friend of Ceth Laike, safely crash-landed and contacted Laike to request evacuation. The Imperial officer quickly assembled a group of operatives and dispatched them to rescue the pilot in the wilderness. However, the first to find the crash site were a group of [[Binayre Pirates|Binayre]] scalawags,<ref name="SWG:E" /> looking for ship parts to salvage.<ref name="P14.1">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=734|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.1 - March 24, 2005}}</ref> The criminals assassinated the TIE pilot on the spot. The Binayres then attacked the rescue team but they were all killed in the fight. The Imperial operatives later reported to Laike. The officer indeed regretted the death of his friend but saw an opportunity to wipe out the criminals that infested the area. As stated in his orders, any attack on Imperial personnel authorized him to take whatever actions he deemed necessary to protect his troops. Ceth Laike therefore ordered strikes on criminals and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the Corellian system. The group of Imperial operatives assaulted a Binayre camp on Talus and killed 15 of them. They also eliminated a band of [[The Flail|Flails]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Eventually, Imperial pilots attacked a group of Binayre [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in Corellian space. All pirate vessels were destroyed and the Binayre leader [[MacDougal|"Black Jack" MacDougal]] was killed in the battle.<ref name="SWG:E" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ceth Laike was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:E" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ceth Laike was added to the game with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Update Notes: March 24, 2005|Publish 14.1]], on [[March 24]], [[2005]].<ref name="P14.1" />
